lifecycle_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Use one long worktree set-comparison wrapper as the sole source of expected, actual, missing, extra, and deletion counts.
lifecycle_operational_negatives.failed_witness: No path cardinality or exception list was rendered; the attempt received zero closeout path-review credit and changed no file.
lifecycle_operational_negatives.failure_signature: The first combined comparison of the 25 expected closeout paths to tracked and untracked worktree changes completed without rendering any scalar result and left no active Git child process.
lifecycle_operational_negatives.passing_witness: The exact-index recovery reports equal expected and staged cardinalities with zero missing, extra, unstaged, untracked, deleted, or inherited-path changes.
lifecycle_operational_negatives.recovery: Stage only the exact expected path array from the committed candidate receipt, then compare the Git index to that same array with separately materialized scalar counts.
lifecycle_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use the Git index as the authoritative precommit set and keep empty-success observations explicit.
